hooks.command:
input=$(cat); case "$input" in *'"stop_hook_active":true'*|*'"stop_hook_active": true'*) exit 0;; esac; cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" || exit 0; command -v npx >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; changed=$(git status --porcelain -- .brain CLAUDE.md AGENTS.md .github/copilot-instructions.md .claude/rules .github/instructions 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; head=$(git rev-parse -q --verify HEAD 2>/dev/null); state=$(git rev-parse --git-path dotbrain-lint-head 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; if [ -z "$changed" ] && [ -f "$state" ] && [ "$head" = "$(cat "$state" 2>/dev/null)" ]; then exit 0; fi; out=$(npx --yes @that-simple/dotbrain@<version> lint 2>&1) || { printf 'dotbrain lint found problems in the brain; fix them before you end:
%s
' "$out" >&2; exit 2; }; printf '%s
' "$head" > "$state"; exit 0
hooks.statusMessage: Checking the brain with dotbrain lint
